Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase. The players and the umpires have made their way out in the middle. Philip Salt and Jason Roy open with their blades for England. Shakib Al Hasan starts the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, Bangladesh have been bundled out for a score of 209 runs and their bowlers will now have to bowl their skins out to defend this one. For the visitors, the onus is on their batters to chase this target down have to take a lead in this series. Which side will get over the line? To find out, do join us for the second essay in a short while.

England's side was positive from the start and kept on picking up wickets at regular intervals. They never let the hosts settle and each of their bowlers was economical. Adil Rashid, Jofra Archer, Moeen Ali, and Mark Wood picked up two wickets each for their side whilst Will Jacks and Chris Woakes have one in their kitty. They struggled a bit at the end but they are certainly the happier side going into the break.

It was a tough day for the hosts as they struggled a bit with the bat on this bowling pitch. The opening start was broken in the fifth over and the wickets kept on tumbling at regular intervals. Najmul Hossain Shanto was the sole batter who stood firm, but the nonstrikers kept on losing wickets. He fell later for a short ball after scoring a half-century. Later, the tailenders added some crucial runs on the board and made their team reach a par total of 209 runs.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! That's it. Moeen Ali takes the final wicket. It is floated and full, on middle and leg. Taijul Islam steps out of the crease and tries to slog it away. The ball lobs off the top-edge. Moeen Ali takes a simple catch moving to his right. Bangladesh end their innings at 209/10.
Full, on leg. Islam tucks it to the on side.
Fraction short, wide of off. Mustafizur Rahman tries to slap it away but misses.
NO BALL! Much fuller, outside off. Mustafizur Rahman looks to chase it but misses. The umpire signals a no ball as the bowler oversteps.
Length and on off, defended out.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jofra Archer gets his second wicket of the match. It is a short ball, around off, nips back in a touch. Taskin Ahmed stays inside the crease and tries to punch it through the line without any footwork. The ball takes a thick inside edge. Jos Buttler takes a sharp catch low to his right.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Jofra Archer

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! The umpire now extends his arms to signal a wide as it goes down the leg side.
Jofra Archer now serves a full toss, outside off. Taskin Ahmed tries to knock it down the park but misses it completely.
Good length, on top of off. Taskin Ahmed tries to heave it away but misses.
Archer serves a length ball, on fourth stump. Taijul Islam taps it to point and takes a quick single.
Length ball, angled into the pads. Taskin Ahmed tucks it to the leg side.
Taijul Islam now pulls this short one behind square on the leg side for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! The tail-enders are frustrating the English bowlers here. It is very full, on the pads. Taijul Islam clips it through mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
LEG BYE! A length ball, on the pads. Taskin Ahmed tries to flick it away but misses. The batters cross for a leg bye.
Short one, on off. Taijul Islam pulls it to mid-wicket for a single. 200 is up for the hosts and the crowd makes a loud cheer.
WIDE! Mark Wood now spills it down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
A short ball, on middle and leg. Taskin Ahmed swivels and tries to pull it away but it deflects off his arm. They collect a leg bye.
On a length just outside off, Taijul Islam looks to block it but gets beaten.
Back of a length and on off, Taskin Ahmed pulls it to square leg for one.
Lands it on off, Taijul Islam miscues his heave towards point for one.
Too full on off, Taijul Islam looks to play at it but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Dot.
In the channel just outside off, Taijul Islam looks to drive it but gets beaten.
Shorter one outside off, Taijul Islam looks to play at it but misses.
Wide! Lands it down leg, Taijul Islam misses his flick.
Bowls it outside off, Taskin Ahmed taps it to the man at point.
FOUR! Lands it outside off, it turns away, Taskin Ahmed opens the face of the bat and guides it through third man for a boundary!
SIX! All the way. Fuller and on off, slower too, Taskin Ahmed gets low and slogs it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Lands it on off, Taskin Ahmed blocks it to mid off.

This one lands on off and turns it sharply off the deck, Taskin Ahmed looks to heave it but gets beaten on the inside edge and gets rapped on his pads. A loud appeal and the finger goes up. Taskin Ahmed goes upstairs. The replay shows that it was missing the bails. The onfield decision is changed to NOT OUT!

Review! Taskin Ahmed takes a review for lbw. The original decision is OUT. The UltraEdge confirms that there is no bat involved. The Ball Tracking shows that the ball is missing the wickets. The on-field decision has to be overturned. Taskin Ahmed stays at the crease.
Quicker one, on off, Taijul Islam guides it to backward point for one.
Short of a length and outside off, Taskin Ahmed looks to slap it but misses.
Lands it on off, Taskin Ahmed eases it to mid off.
Too full and outside off, Taijul Islam drives it to deep covers for one.
Taijul Islam comes in at number 10.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! On a length and outside off, shaping away and pace on. Mehidy Hasan looks to guide it but ends up getting a thick outside edge. It lobs behind the sticks and Jos Buttler takes a fine catch diving to his right. Thing are going bad to worse for the hosts now!
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Jofra Archer

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls it on off, Mehidy Hasan defends it to mid on.
Too full and on off, Mehidy Hasan blocks it back.
Lands it down leg, Mehidy Hasan tickles it to fine leg for one. He keeps his strike for the next over.
Quicker one, on off, Taskin Ahmed tucks it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Wide! Bowls it down leg, Taskin Ahmed looks to sweep it but misses.
Bowls it on off, Mehidy Hasan taps it to covers for one.
Lands it on off, Mehidy Hasan guides it to the man at short third man.
Bowls it on off, it keeps a tad low, Taskin Ahmed clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Quicker one, on middle, Taskin Ahmed eases it to covers.
Shorter and on middle, Mehidy Hasan looks to pull it but misses.
Bowls it shorter and on off, Mehidy Hasan fends it to backward point.
Full and on off, shaping away, Mehidy Hasan eases it to covers.
Lands it on off, Taskin Ahmed taps it to point for one.
Lands it on middle and leg, Mehidy Hasan tickles it to fine leg for one.
Short and wide, Mehidy Hasan slaps it but finds the man at point.
Taskin Ahmed walks in now. Also, it is time for Powerplay 3! Now, 5 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle until the end of the innings.

OUT! CAUGHT! Will Jacks strikes and gets his maiden ODI wicket. He will surely remember it for a long, long time. It is tossed up, full and on off. Afif Hossain bends his knee and goes for the slog sweep, although he does not middle it. It flies off the inner half towards mid on. Adil Rashid takes a dolly at mid on.
Commentary.Howout: c Adil Rashid b Will Jacks

Commentary.Commentary: A single now as this full one is hit down to long on.
WIDE! This is floated, and full, sliding down leg. Wide called.
Tossed up, on off, eases to the left of the bowler.
Full and on leg. Hossain clips it to mid-wicket for one.
A single now as this is knocked down to long on.
Full and on off, defended out.
Fuller, angled into the pads. Mehidy Hasan flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fraction short, in the channel. Mehidy Hasan tries to punch it away, although it takes an inside edge and bounces over the sticks.
Length, on fourth stump, jagging back in touch. Mehidy Hasan fends it to the off side.
Length, on leg. Afif Hossain flicks it through square leg for one.
Afif Hossain charges down the track to this good-length ball, on off. Afif Hossain tries to heave it across the line. It takes an inside edge on to his pads.
On a length, around off. It holds into the surface. Afif Hossain blocks it back to the bowler.
A bit short, on off. Afif Hossain works it down to long on for a single.
Full, on off. Afif Hossain presses forward and blocks it into the deck.
Floats it up, around off, it grips and spins away sharply. Hossain tries to defend it but does so inside the line.
Flatter, outside off. Hasan punches it to sweeper cover and gets off the mark with a single.
Full, outside off. Afif Hossain drives it to deep point for one.
FOUR! Wonderful shot. It is a short one, outside off. Afif Hossain goes back and cuts it through cover for a fine boundary.
Mehidy Hasan walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Mark Wood gets his second wicket of the innings. Mark Wood dishes a full-length ball, sliding down leg. Mahmudullah stays back and tries to glance it around the corner. Jos Buttler dives to that side and takes a sharp catch. He is up and makes an appeal. The umpire converge and take it upstairs. The soft-signal is Not Out. Although, the UltraEdge shows a spike as the ball crosses the blade. A huge wicket for England. The crowd has gone silent now.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Mark Wood

Commentary.Commentary: A length, on the pads. Hossain tucks it to mid-wicket but does not take a single here.
It is a short ball, around middle and off. Afif Hossain bends his knees and tries to go for the ramp shot. Although he fails to get any bat on ball.
Wood goes full, angling into the pads. Mahmudullah stays back to clips it towards deep square leg. Only one taken as there is protection in the deep.
WIDE! A sharp bouncer, sliding down leg. The umpire extends his arms and signals a wide.
Length, on off, defended back to the bowler.
Back of a length, in the channel. Mahmudullah tries to hit it through the line but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Afif Hossain walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Adil Rashid strikes against the run of play here and Najmul Hossain Shanto is in shock. He cannot believe that Jason Roy has managed to hold on to this one. It is slightly short, around off. Najmul Hossain Shanto swivels and pulls it hard towards mid-wicket, although he does not middle it. In fact it comes off the toe end. Jason Roy takes a sharp catch going to his right at chest height.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter, on the pads. Mahmudullah goes back and clips it to square leg for a single.
Goes full and on leg. Shanto nudges it to the leg side and crosses.
On off, defended to the leg side.
Short, on leg. Mahmudullah pulls it behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! It is looped up, around middle and leg. Mahmudullah goes down on one knee and sweeps it through the gap at mid-wicket for a cracking boundary. This should release some pressure.
Wood goes short, in the channel. Mahmudullah steers it down to third man for a single.
Wood bends his back hard and serves a short ball, on off. Mahmudullah hangs back and sways away from the line of the delivery.
A sharp bouncer, on middle. Mahmudullah ducks under this one.
Najmul Hossain Shanto works this length ball towards mid on and takes a quick single.
This is a length ball, angled across. Najmul Hossain Shanto throws the kitchen sink at it but gets an inside edge towards the keeper. Fortunately for him, it meets the keeper on a bounce.
Back of a length, outside off. Mahmudullah hops and punches it past point for a single.
A single now as this is worked towards deep point.
Flatter, on middle. Mahmudullah goes back and knocks it to mid on.
Goes full, on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto gets it to the off side off the leading edge, as he tries to flick it away. One taken.
FOUR! Exceptional shot! It is tossed up, on off. Shanto now reverse-sweeps it through backward point. It races away to the fence.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off for one.
Floated and full, around off. It turns away sharply. Mahmudullah goes chasing at first but does not go through with his shot.
It is full, tucking into the pads. Mahmudullah flicks it to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Top shot! It is a good-length ball, in the channel. Mahmudullah waits for it and punches it late past backward point. He gets it through the gap and it races away to the fence.
LEG BYE! On the pads once again, Najmul Hossain Shanto fails to glance it around the corner. It goes to square leg off the pads and they collect a leg bye.
Wood continues to attack the leg stump. This one stays low as well. Shanto fails to work it to the leg side. He gets pinged on his pads but just outside the line.
Wood goes full, down leg. Shanto goes back and tries to flick it away. He misses to take another blow on his pads.
A length ball, on leg, this one stays a bit low. Shanto fails to tuck it away. He takes a blow on his pads.

Drinks! Bangladesh are currently on 136/4 and they will need to gear up now to put up a challenging total on the board. England will look for some quick wickets in the game and put the hosts under pressure. The pitch has a lot to offer for the bowlers, especially the spinners, and anything above 260 will be a good score for the hosts.
A googly now, around off, turning in sharply. Mahmudullah stays inside the crease but is unable to put it away. He wears a blow on his thigh pads.
A bit flatter, outside off. Mahmudullah looks to chase it but misses.
Full and on off. Shanto gets low and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
WIDE! Floats it up, turning down leg. Najmul Hossain Shanto misses to flick it away. Wide called.
On off, blocked out.

Adil Rashid gives it a bit more flight this time, around off. Najmul Hossain Shanto tries to punch it through the line but misses. The ball grips and turns in sharply with some extra bounce. Moeen Ali gathers it at leg slip. Boy, what was this bounce!
WIDE! Fuller, down the leg side. The umpire signals a wide.
It is flatter, angled across the left-hander, outside off. Shanto tries to defend it out but gets beaten on the inside edge.
A length ball, on off, blocked out solidly.

MAIDEN ODI FIFTY for Shanto. An incredible knock against a strong England side. It is a bit short, around the hips. Najmul Hossain Shanto clips it behind square on the leg side and crosses. A standing ovation from the crowd and the dressing room as well.
A length ball, on leg. Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it through square leg and collects a brace.
WIDE! A sharp bouncer, on off. Shanto tries to heave it across the line but misses. The umpire signals a wide as the ball goes over the head.
A length ball, on the pads, Shnto nudges it to the leg side.
Archer steams in from 'round the wicket and dishes a good-length ball, on off. Shanto drags his pull to short mid-wicket.
Full length, on fourth stump. Shanto pushes it gently towards backward point.
Some turn and bounce, outside off, Mahmudullah looks to play at it but misses.
Short and wide, Shanto cuts it to point for one.
Darts it on off, Shanto eases it to the mid on fielder.
Lands it on off, Mahmudullah pushes it to covers for a single.
Fuller one on leg, it turns away, Mahmudullah looks to block it but gets rapped on his pads. A loud appeal but turned down. They decide not to review it. Perhaps missing leg.
Some turn and bounce, outside off as it beats Mahmudullah on the outside edge towards the keeper.
On a length and on off, Shanto blocks it away solidly.
Shorter and on off, Shanto looks to work it to the leg side but gets a top edge. It lobs in the air and lands safely at the vacant silly point region. Safe!
Good length, angling in, Shanto steers it to the point fielder.
Shorter one, on off, Shanto guides it to the man at short third man.
On a length, angling in, Mahmudullah works it to mid-wicket for one.
Lands it outside off, Mahmudullah eases it to the gully fielder.
Short and wide, Shanto cuts it but finds the man at point.
Touch fuller with a hint of turn, Mahmudullah drills it to long on for one.
Lands it fuller again, Mahmudullah eases it to the cover fielder.
Too full and on off, Mahmudullah blocks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Tossed up, outside off, Shanto drives it to covers for one.
Darts it on leg, Mahmudullah turns it to square leg for one.
Some extra bounce, on leg, Mahmudullah misses his flick and gets rapped on his pads. The ball rolls towards the right of the keeper as the batters collect a leg bye.
Bowls it on off, Mahmudullah tucks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Short and wide, Shanto slaps it to point for one.
Bowls it outside off, Shanto looks to play at it but gets rapped on his pads.
Lands it on middle, Mahmudullah miscues his flick towards point for one.
On a length and on off, Mahmudullah drives it but finds the man at covers.
Change. Jofra Archer comes back into the attack now.
Lands it on off, Shanto tucks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Some turn and bounce this time, Shanto looks to play at it but misses.
Good length, on middle, Mahmudullah tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker one, Shanto drives it to covers for a single.
Fuller one, angling in, Mahmudullah drills it to long on for one.
Bowls it on off, Mahmudullah eases it to the on side.
On a length and on leg, Mahmudullah looks to flick it but gets an inside edge as the ball rolls towards fine leg. They cross.
FOUR! Fine shot. Fuller and on off, Mahmudullah moves forward and lofts it over mid off as the ball races away from the fence.
Short and wide, Shanto cuts it to point for one.
Bowls it on off, Mahmudullah pushes it to point for one.
Fuller and on off, Mahmudullah defends it forward.
Shorter and wide outside off, Shanto drives it to covers for one.
Flatter and angling in, Mahmudullah eases it to mid-wicket.
Lands it on off, Mahmudullah turns it to square leg.
A single now as this is pushed to cover.
Tossed up, on off, Mahmudullah uses his feet and works it to mid-wicket for one.
Around off, defended back.
Fuller one, this is defended towards short covers.
Bowls it on off, Mahmudullah drives it to covers for a single.
Fuller and on off, Mahmudullah drives it to covers for one.
Mahmudullah is the new man at the crease.

OUT! TIMBER! Full and straight angling in, Shakib goes for the wild slog sweep shot across the line and misses it. The ball holds it line and goes onto hit the stumps. Shakib Al Hasan makes his way back into the hut.
Fuller and on off, Shakib Al Hasan drives it to covers for a brace.
Lands it on off, Shanto drills it to long off for one.
Fuller and on off, Shanto blocks it forward.
Bowls it on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto drives it to covers for one.
Lands it on off, this is played towards the man at mid off.
Fuller length outside off, Shakib plays the slog sweep and gets a top edge. It carries and lands safely at square leg. They cross.
On off, defended out.
Fuller length, angling in, Shakib pushes to short cover.
FOUR! Shorter and slower too, Shakib Al Hasan hangs back and slaps it through point for a boundary!
Lands it on middle and leg, Shakib Al Hasan flicks it to square leg for one. He gets off the mark.
Around off, played towards covers.
Bowls it outside off, this is played towards point.
Flatter and on off, Shakib Al Hasan eases it back.
Lands it on off, this is pushed to covers for one.
Full and on off, this is defended back towards the bowler.
It is full, in-line with the stumps. Shakib Al Hasan whips it to short mid-wicket but could not find the gap. A successful over from Adil Rashid comes to an end.
Floated and full, on off, defended out.
Shakib Al Hasan walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! This time England need not wait for any time to start their celebrations. Finally, Adil Rashid is the one who finds the breakthrough. It is tossed up, around middle. It grips and turns away. Mushfiqur Rahim gets down and plays it against the turn, as he slogs it to deep mid-wicket. He does not get the desired distance on it. Mark Wood takes a sharp catch diving forward in the deep.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Wood b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: Looped up, full, on off. Mushfiqur Rahim miscues it back to the bowler.
On off, defended to point.
Fuller, on leg stump. Shanto flicks it through mid-wicket and crosses.
Touch short, on off. Rahim fends it to backward point.
On off, defended out.
This is fired fuller and on leg. Mushfiqur Rahim goes back and dabs it out watchfully.
Mushfiqur Rahim gets down on one knee to this full one and goes for the sweep but misses it completely.
Outside off, pushed to point.
Flatter and on off. Shanto punches it to mid off and crosses.
A single now as this is worked through mid-wicket.

Najmul Hossain Shanto gets a lifeline here and crowd errupts here. It is a flighted full toss, on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto whips it towards short mid-wicket. Jason Roy takes the ball low to the ground and lobs it up to complete the catch. The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The soft-signal is OUT, although the third umpire has enough evidence to rule this one in favour of the home side.
A single now as this is clipped towards mid on.
Gives it some air this time, on off. Rahim eases it to short cover.
On leg, Shanto tucks it to square leg for one more.
Tosses it up, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim gets on his front foot, pushes it to cover for one.
Full and on off, blocked out solidly.
Ali serves it on the pads. Mushfiqur Rahim flicks it to square leg for one.
On off, defended out.

SIX! Fortunate boundary. Philip Salt almost took a stunner in the deep but froze a bit near the ropes which led to a biggie. It is short, on off. Rahim pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Philip Salt back-pedals in the deep, he grabs the ball but the momentum takes him over the ropes. Philip Salt was in position to toss the ball in the air, but was a bit late into the movement as his back leg touched the ground past the ropes.
Much quicker and full, on off. It turns in off the deck. Mushfiqur Rahim prods and tries to defend but misses. A stifled appeal for lbw but turned down.
Floated and full, on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto drives it down to long off for a single.
Mushfiqur Rahim stays back to this length ball and dabs it towards backward point.
A bouncer this time, on middle. Mushfiqur Rahim bends his knee and lets the ball sail over him.
Shorter, on the bodyline. Shanto hops and flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Full and on off, defended out.
FOUR! Smacked! Back of a length, on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto rides the bounce and pulls it to deep square leg for four runs.
LEG BYE! It is full, sliding down leg. Mushfiqur Rahim fails to flick it away. The ball brushes the pads and rolls out to square leg. They collect a leg bye.

Drinks! Bangladesh are currently on 75/2 and will be hoping to carry on. Mushfiqur Rahim and Najmul Hossain Shanto are looking well settled in the middle and they will look to put up a good total on the board. England will be looking for some quick wickets in the game.

A bit of miscommunication but no damage done. It is tossed up, on off. Rahim pushes it gently towards point. Rahim ventures out for a single but is sent back. Jos Buttler overthrows and the batters sneak a single eventually.
Najmul Hossain Shanto goes back and flicks it off his pads to the leg side for a single.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary. It is a half-tracker, on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto goes on his back foot and slaps it past mid off for four runs.
Pushed through quicker, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto fends it to point.
A single now as this is knocked down to long on.
Mark Wood serves a short ball, on fourth stump. Najmul Hossain Shanto gets it to point off the outer half.
Shoter, tailing into the pads. Najmul Hossain Shanto nudges it to the leg side.
Back of a length, on middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto pulls it to deep square leg for a brace.
WIDE! A sharp bouncer, on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto tries to hook it away but misses. He gets beaten by the outside edge. It is way to high for the umpire and signals a wide.
Mark Wood serves a full-length ball, on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto stays back and fends it out to safety.
Length and on off, blocked out.
Mark Wood changes the angle by coming around the wicket. It is a short ball, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto rides the bounce and cuts it through point for a brace.
Tossed up, on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto eases it to the off side and takes another single.
Half-tracker once again, turning in from outside off. Rahim dabs it to point and gets to the other end.
Shorter, on middle. Shanto pulls it to deep mid-wicket and crosses.
Flatter, on leg pole. Mushfiqur Rahim clips it past square leg for one run.
Darted on the pads. Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it to square leg for a single.
Ali comes from 'round the wicket and angles it in full and leg. Shanto gets an inside edge on his pads.
Change. Time for some spin now as Moeen Ali comes into the attack.
It is a short ball, angled down the leg side. Najmul Hossain Shanto swivels and pulls it to deep square leg for a single. A tidy over from Wood comes to an end.
Najmul Hossain Shanto stays back to this length ball and fends it out to the off side.
On a length, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim guides it down to third man and gets a single this time. It has been a while since Bangladesh scored a boundary.
BEATEN! Beauifully bowled! Woakes dishes a length ball, in the channel. Mushfiqur Rahim tries to have a poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A well-directed short ball, on middle. Mushfiqur Rahim ducks under it wisely.
Length ball, drifting down leg. Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it behind square on the leg side for one.
Fuller in length, on off. Mushfiqur Rahim stays inside the crease and jams it out to safety. Just a single off the over then.
Chris Woakes dishes a short ball, on off. Mushfiqur Rahim goes back and dabs it to the off side.
Mushfiqur Rahim stays back to this length ball and fends it back to the bowler.
A bit short, outside off, shaping away. Mushfiqur Rahim lets it be.
On a length, wide of off. Mushfiqur Rahim hangs his bat away from his body and gets it to backward point off the outer half.
Good-length ball, on top of off. Najmul Hossain Shanto stays inside the crease and knocks it through covers for a single.
Powerplay 1 comes to an end. Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end on the 40th over.
Lands it outside off, and some extra bounce, Mushfiqur Rahim looks to play at it but misses.
Too full and on off, Mushfiqur Rahim blocks it back towards the bowler.
Shorter and on off, Mushfiqur Rahim looks to pull it but gets a top edge. It goes towards fine leg. The fielder stops it well to his right near the ropes. They collect two.
On a length and on off, Mushfiqur Rahim eases it to the man at point. Oh, its a no ball. Free hit coming up...
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! Peach of a delivery! Tamim Iqbal's cameo comes to an end. On a length and some extra bounce off the deck, on off, Tamim Iqbal misses it completely as he gets an inside edge and the ball rattles over the stumps. Tamim Iqbal makes his way back into the hut.
Fuller and on off, Iqbal eases it to square leg.
On a length and outside off, Iqbal leaves it alone.
Change. Mark Wood comes into the attack now.
Good length, angling in, Shanto eases it to covers.
FOUR MORE! Overpitched and on off, Shanto picks it well and drills it through mid on as the ball races away from the fence in no time.
FOUR! Lands it on off, Shanto hangs back and drives it through covers for a boundary!
Bowls it on off, Iqbal pulls it to square leg for one.
